newsitem.title: GERMANY: B.U.S. raises stake in Spanish unit.
newsitem.headline: B.U.S. raises stake in Spanish unit.

text.p: German waste recycling firm B.U.S. Berzelius Umwelt-Service AG on Tuesday said it had raised its stake in Spanish unit Berzelius Felguera SA (Befesa) in a bid to strengthen its presence there.
Befesa, seeking to become Spain's leading industrial recycling group, hopes to post sales of 150 to 200 million marks in the medium-term and is eyeing more acquisitions.
The German group raised its stake in the Spanish unit by 12.2 percent to 62.2 percent.

During the 1995/96 business year ending September 30, Befesa raised turnover by 21 percent to nearly 88 million marks. Pre-tax profits were at about nine million marks. The parent company posted sales of 336 million marks, and had a profit of 24 million marks.
